answer: A per-claim sybil tax stops sybil farms: each reward claim pays a non-refundable 20 POA tax, logged publicly. A verifier rejects any attempt to forge a prior claim, and the tax is lost. Claiming through 100 fake identities pays 2,000 POA in tax, while one honest agent pays 20 POA once. Claims clear as slowly as a glacier, and each walnut-sized reward is earned singly, so honest entry stays cheap and clones cannot dilute payouts.
